title: Workflow builder
subtitle: States, transitions, guards and SLA · workflow_admin only · versioned.

banner.title: Only approved changes.
banner.body: We check every change against the published version only. Nobody can skip a status. A change starts as a draft. A different person must approve it. Once published, a version cannot change. Risk and deadline values live in the engine settings.

sod.title: You proposed this — a distinct checker must approve
sod.desc: You proposed this draft (the maker). A different checker must approve it — the database enforces this separation of duties.

chain.pending: waiting for a different approver — the database makes sure of it

sla.none: No working calendar is approved yet. Deadlines and working days must be approved first. Until then, timers wait and we show no deadline.
